## Checks

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run smoke` pass
- [ ] `showcase:bake -- --check`, `showcase:lightmaps -- --verify`, `budget`, `licences` pass (when worlds, rendering, assets or dependencies changed)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; browser suite run for UI or renderer changes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/` updated
- [ ] No secrets, large binaries or unlicensed assets
